host.runtimeLayout: Installation prefix omitted; hashes identify the actual host and loaded runtime bytes.

policy.cold: One import and first packet invocation in a fresh process; OS caches are not evicted.
policy.warm: Five repeated packet invocations in the same loaded module.

modules.probeScript: $root = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('pf-corpus-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null; try { $source = Join-Path $root 'source.txt'; $zip = Join-Path $root 'archive.zip'; $expanded = Join-Path $root 'expanded'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($source, 'ok', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); Compress-Archive -LiteralPath $source -DestinationPath $zip; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $expanded; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $expanded 'source.txt'))) { throw 'Archive roundtrip failed.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force }; 'ok'

assemblyIdentityBasis: Typed assembly digests copied from the byte-identified input inventories. Timing observations and summaries are unchanged.
